children: Bitcoin rose about 5.34% over the past 24 hours to $60,876.83, climbing back above $60,000 after sliding toward the high-$50,000s earlier in the week.Below is a look at the macroeconomic data that will be released this week. Monday: November flash PMIs, with manufacturing previously at 56 and services at 57.9, plus a speech from New York Fed President John Williams at 4:00 PM ET.Additionally, the OCC's comment period on the information collection behind GENIUS Act payment stablecoin issuer applications closes. The OCC has said it will begin accepting applications only after OMB approves the collection and the agency announces the opening. The broader GENIUS Act framework takes effect January 18, 2027.Wednesday: 8:30 AM ET, the October PCE price index and the second estimate of Q3 GDP will be published together, alongside the Fed's Beige Book later that afternoon. Consensus points to headline PCE at 3.8% year over year, up from 3.6%, with core at 3.2% from 3.1%. Both are expected to rise 0.3% month over month. Q3 GDP is seen revised up to 3.6% from 3.4%.Thursday: Thanksgiving holiday in the US, with no data releases scheduled and markets will be closed. Friday: October's advance U.S. trade balance in goods, and retail and wholesale inventories.

title: Week Ahead: PCE and GDP Data Land Wednesday, Stablecoin Licensing Nears Its Deadline
